balls.name: Range Rock
balls.blurb: Plain white and unlimited. No tricks.

balls.name: Rocket Core
balls.blurb: 6% more ball speed. Hits the green like a skipping stone.

balls.name: Featherlite Spin
balls.blurb: Bites hard and stops fast on greens.

balls.name: Skipper
balls.blurb: Skips across water twice before it sinks. Keep it low.

balls.name: Mudder
balls.blurb: Shrugs off soggy ground. Bounces and rolls as if the course were dry.

balls.name: Windcutter
balls.blurb: Dimples tuned to ignore more than half of the wind.

balls.name: Gyro Straight
balls.blurb: Barely hooks or slices, however ugly the swing.

balls.name: Sand Shark
balls.blurb: Pops out of bunkers as if they were fairway.

balls.name: Cup Magnet
balls.blurb: The hole plays nearly twice as wide.
